card.text: Explore Moshup in 3D with its published shape model and radial elevation.

introduction.text: Moshup is the primary of the near-Earth binary asteroid formerly designated 1999 KW4. Its radar reconstruction has a pronounced equatorial ridge. Explore its original shape and radial heights. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Radar shape model
shape.summary: Shape from radar observations. The gray grid marks missing optical imagery; lighting shows the model.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Distance above or below a reference sphere. Colors include the body's shape as well as local terrain.
